properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Developer interpreter / package-manager process exfiltrating tokens to public code-hosting / worker domains
properties.description:
Detects the multi-stage Miasma/Hades supply-chain pattern: a package manager (npm/pip/yarn/pnpm/uv) or its lifecycle hook spawns a script interpreter (node, python, bash, powershell), which within a short window reads local credential/token stores (.npmrc, .pypirc, .aws/credentials, .git-credentials, .env, browser SQLite cookie DBs) and egresses to a non-registry public-code-hosting or anonymous-worker endpoint (raw.githubusercontent.com, gist.github.com, *.workers.dev, *.trycloudflare.com, *.web.app, transfer.sh, telegram bot API). The fortnight's Miasma compromise of @redhat-cloud-services (Microsoft 2026-06-03), the Hades PyPI splinter (THN 2026-06-09), the 73 Microsoft GitHub repos pulled offline (THN 2026-06-09), and the WinRAR CVE-2025-8088 stealer chains reaching the same Cloudflare-Worker dead-drops (THN 2026-06-09) all converge on this exact preinstall->cred-harvest->bidirectional-C2 chain. Spans Initial Access (T1195.002), Execution (T1059), Credential Access (T1552.001/T1555.003), Exfiltration (T1567/T1102.002). Fires when ALL three stages co-occur on one host within 10 minutes; does NOT fire on a clean `npm install` against a registry (registry.npmjs.org / pypi.org are excluded), on isolated cred-file reads by password managers, or on developer git pushes that don't follow a package-install event.

Rationale: Every article this fortnight (Miasma npm, Hades PyPI, Microsoft's 73 GitHub repo pulls, the WinRAR delivery chains) ends in the same three-event sequence on a developer or build host: package-manager spawns interpreter, interpreter reads credential artifacts, interpreter or its child egresses to a public anonymous-worker / code-host dead-drop. Detecting on that joint sequence — rather than the rotating package names, hashes or domains — keeps the rule alive across the campaign's known splinters and the next ecosystem to be targeted.
properties.query:
let Window = 10m;
let RegistryHosts = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","index.docker.io","ghcr.io","crates.io"]);
let PublicDropDomains = dynamic(["workers.dev","trycloudflare.com","web.app","raw.githubusercontent.com","gist.github.com","transfer.sh","ngrok.io","ngrok-free.app","api.telegram.org","discord.com","discordapp.com","pastebin.com"]);
let CredArtifacts = dynamic([".npmrc",".pypirc","credentials",".git-credentials","id_rsa","id_ed25519","config.json",".env","Login Data","Cookies","key4.db","logins.json"]);
let PkgMgrParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip","pip.exe","pip3","pip3.exe","uv","uv.exe","poetry","poetry.exe","node.exe","node"]);
let ScriptChildren = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","sh","curl.exe","wget.exe"]);
let PkgInstallStage = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2d)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrParents)
    | where FileName in~ (ScriptChildren)
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("install","add","preinstall","postinstall","lifecycle","build","ci")
    | project InstallTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              PkgMgr = InitiatingProcessFileName, ChildProc = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let CredReadStage = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2d)
    | where FileName in~ (CredArtifacts) or FolderPath has_any (".aws",".ssh","User Data\\Default",".npm",".config\\gh")
    | project CredTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, CredFile = FolderPath, CredInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName;
let EgressStage = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(2d)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
    | where not(RemoteUrl has_any (RegistryHosts))
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (PublicDropDomains)
    | project EgressTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, EgressInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName;
PkgInstallStage
| join kind=inner CredReadStage on DeviceId
| where CredTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + Window)
| join kind=inner EgressStage on DeviceId
| where EgressTime between (InstallTime .. InstallTime + Window)
| where EgressInitiator in~ (ScriptChildren) or CredInitiator in~ (ScriptChildren)
| summarize InstallTime = min(InstallTime), CredFiles = make_set(CredFile, 25),
            DropDomains = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25), DropIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 25)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, PkgMgr, ChildProc, ChildCmd
| order by InstallTime desc
